question: Which of the private equity, alternatives and real assets consultant RFPs in the corpus identify the incumbent or existing consultants, who are they, and may the incumbent compete?
gold_answer: Baltimore BCERS alternatives consultant RFP: incumbent alternatives consultant is the Meketa Group, which may submit a proposal; the general consultant Marquette Associates may not. SBCERS 2020 PE consultant RFP: incumbent PE consultant is Hamilton Lane, invited to rebid. DC Retirement Board real assets RFP (2011): The Townsend Group is the incumbent specialist real assets consultant and is expected to respond; Meketa Investment Group (general consultant) is also expected to respond (Pantheon is the PE specialist). Arizona PSPRS non-discretionary consultant RFP: the Board's own fiduciary consultant NEPC is not up for bid (the procurement is for a consultant to the CIO and investment team). INPRS, FPIF, TRS Illinois FY25, LAGERS and the Hawaii RFPs do not name an incumbent.
acceptance: Require the specialist incumbents and their stated eligibility. Marquette exclusion is material when discussing BCERS existing consultants. Treat Arizona/NEPC as additional scope context rather than forcing it into a specialist-only interpretation. Pantheon bid eligibility is not stated.
candidate_answer:
Three specialist-consultant RFPs explicitly identify the incumbent and address whether it may compete:

| RFP | Incumbent or existing consultant | May it compete? |
|---|---|---|
| **Santa Barbara County Employees’ Retirement System — private equity (2020)** | **Hamilton Lane** is the incumbent private equity consultant. | **Yes.** The RFP expressly invites it to rebid. [SBCERS RFP, p. 9](SBCERS__2020-Private-Equity-RFP.pdf) |
| **Baltimore City Employees’ Retirement System — alternatives (2024)** | **Meketa Group** is the incumbent alternatives consultant. **Marquette Associates** is the separate general investment consultant. | **Meketa may submit a proposal; Marquette may not** compete in this alternatives search. [BCERS RFP, pp. 8–9](Baltimore_BCERS__RFP-Alternatives-Consultant-rev.pdf) |
| **District of Columbia Retirement Board — real assets (2011)** | **The Townsend Group** is the incumbent real-assets specialist. The RFP also identifies **Meketa Investment Group** as general consultant and **Pantheon** as private-equity specialist. | **Yes.** Townsend is expected to respond; Meketa is also expected to respond. [DCRB RFP, pp. 3–4](DC_Retirement_Board__dcrb-rfp-real-assets-investment-consulting-services.pdf) |

A related **Oklahoma TRS general/private-markets RFP** names **Meketa Investment Group** as its *existing private-markets back-office provider*, not as the incumbent for the consulting work being solicited. Its reporting, fee-validation and capital-call services are expressly outside this search; the RFP does not expressly say whether Meketa will bid. [Oklahoma TRS RFP, p. 10](Oklahoma_TRS__Investment.Consultant.RFP.adopted.by.Board.pdf)
